title: ClientConfigResponse
description:
The response that contains the client configuration.

Introduced in VPP License Management 2.0.

Client config should be checked regularly in order to verify expected values for the various fields.

countryISO2ACode.description: The ISO alpha-2 country code that designates the organization’s location.

defaultPlatform.description: The value that the MDM client passes for the platform parameter in the `contentMetadataLookup` request. For more information about how the MDM client queries metadata by using `contentMetadataLookup`, see [Getting app and book information (Legacy)](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicemanagement/getting-app-and-book-information-legacy).

locationName.description: The current name of the library.

mdmInfo.description:
The current information for the provided token.

The response only includes this field when the MDM client sets a value using the [Client Config](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicemanagement/client-config-4szk1) endpoint.

notificationAuthToken.description: The current shared secret that the server returns in the Authorization header of notifications.

notificationUrl.description: The current URL to post notifications to.

subscribedNotificationTypes.description: The set of currently subscribed notification types.

tokenExpirationDate.description:
The token’s expiration date in an ISO-8601 format.

Note: The server shows all dates and times in UTC.

uId.description: The unique library identifier. When querying records using multiple tokens that may share libraries, use the `uId` field to filter duplicates and avoid double-counting records when different content managers upload duplicate tokens.

websiteURL.description: The current website URL for the specified platform.
